title: Comparison of the insulin action parameters from hyperinsulinemic clamps with homeostasis model assessment and QUICKI indexes in subjects with different endocrine disorders.
source_type: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
text_summary: 本研究的目的是比较患有影响胰岛素作用的各种疾病的受试者中高胰岛素钳夹、稳态模型评估 (HOMA) 和 QUICKI 指数所表达的胰岛素敏感性。我们检查了 41 名 2 型糖尿病患者、20 名胰岛素瘤患者、32 名多囊卵巢综合征女性、16 名原发性醛固酮增多症患者、12 名原发性高肾素高血压患者和 47 名健康受试者。在整个 168 名受试者队列中，体重指数与胰岛素敏感性指数密切相关（r = -0.70；P < 0.0001）。在外周或肝脏胰岛素作用不同程度受损的极少数情况下，HOMA 和 QUICKI 指数无法提供与葡萄糖钳夹相同的信息。

          The Growth Hormone Research Society intends to award two Research Fellowships in 2004 to promote
            international exchange of scientific and clinical research expertise in any area of GH-related research. Awards
            of US $40,000 will provide personal salary support and travel costs for a post-doctoral scientist or clinical
            training fellow wishing to pursue a research project for one year in a host institution of their choice. For
